title: Cloud-Storage Usage and Cost Runway
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=clouddrive:usage
| stats latest(used_gb) as used, latest(quota_gb) as quota, avg(daily_growth_gb) as growth by provider
| eval pct=round(100*used/quota,1), days_to_full=round((quota-used)/growth,0)
| sort - pct
description: Tracks how full each cloud drive is and predicts when you will hit the limit and face an upgrade.
value: A storage runway lets you clean up or plan an upgrade calmly instead of hitting a full-drive wall mid-backup.
implementation: Ingest cloud-storage usage into `index=personal`; predict days to full per provider.
visualization: Gauge of cloud-storage usage with days-to-full.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how full your cloud storage is and predicts when you will run out and need to pay for more.
